title: Raid on Málaga (1656)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Raid on Málaga (1656)", at revision 1370705940, opens: "The Raid on Malaga was a military action by the English against the Spanish city of Málaga on 21 July 1656 as part of the Anglo–Spanish War (1654–1660)." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1034162, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1656 conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
